facts.text: The resort is perched atop a coastal cliff with access to a private beach.
facts.excerpt: perched atop a breathtaking coastal cliff, with access to a private beach

facts.text: The resort is built into the natural landscape of the southern coastline of Isla Mujeres.
facts.excerpt: a resort built gracefully into the natural landscape of Isla Mujeres’ southern coastline

facts.text: The private beach has a naturally sheltered setting that is seldom affected by sargassum.
facts.excerpt: a private beach whose naturally sheltered setting is seldom affected by sargassum

facts.text: The resort is designed for adults, for relaxation or a romantic getaway.
facts.excerpt: an oasis tailored for adults seeking an exceptional escape from the ordinary, whether it's for relaxation or a romantic getaway

facts.text: Every stay includes a dedicated butler.
facts.excerpt: relax completely as your dedicated butler ensures the perfect stay

facts.text: Suites have in-suite wine refrigerators, private balconies, dual rain showers and premium bath amenities.
facts.excerpt: amenities such as butler service, in-suite wine refridgerators, private balconies, dual rain showers and premium bath amenities

facts.text: Room categories range from Junior Suites to Presidential Suites with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Room categories range from Junior Suites to Presidential Suites with ocean views.

facts.text: The all-inclusive stay includes unlimited premium spirits, a la carte dining, and curated activities and entertainment.
facts.excerpt: unlimited premium spirits and gourmet à la carte dining crafted by master chefs, curated activities and entertainment

facts.text: There are seven dining venues, including two signature restaurants, Spezia and UNIK The Kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Our seven dining venues, including two signature restaurants – Spezia and UNIK The Kitchen

facts.text: Dining is reservation-free.
facts.excerpt: Dining is reservation-free

facts.text: Guests can watch the sunset from overwater torch-lit cabanas.
facts.excerpt: bask in perfect sunsets from our overwater torch-lit cabanas

facts.text: The rooftop terrace has 360-degree views.
facts.excerpt: Capture the stunning 360-degree views from our spectacular rooftop terrace

facts.text: A four-story waterslide drops guests into the ocean.
facts.excerpt: plunge into the ocean from our four-story waterslide

facts.text: The resort has rooftop infinity pools.
facts.excerpt: Highlights include rooftop infinity pools

facts.text: PURE SPA by Natura Bisse offers hydrotherapy, Hammam cleansing therapy and a Floatarium.
facts.excerpt: PURE SPA by Natura Bissé offers hydrotherapy, Hammam cleansing therapy and a Floatarium.

facts.text: Guests can explore Isla Mujeres by electric bike or complimentary cruiser.
facts.excerpt: explore the peaceful island of Isla Mujeres by electric bike or complimentary cruiser

facts.text: Guests can watch the sunset at sea aboard the resort's private boat.
facts.excerpt: or at sea aboard our private boat

facts.text: The architecture and art by local artists represent the local community.
facts.excerpt: Stunning architectural design and art by local artists represent our community

facts.text: The resort uses solar panels for water heating, has no single-use plastics on property and runs an on-site glass bottling plant.
facts.excerpt: solar panels for water heating, no single-use plastics on property and an on-site glass bottling plant

facts.text: The resort partners with the Saving Our Sharks Foundation, and most furniture is locally made.
facts.excerpt: partners with the Saving Our Sharks Foundation. Most furniture is locally made

facts.text: Activities include snorkeling, paddleboarding, yoga, cooking and mixology classes, and golf access at Puerto Cancun Golf Club.
facts.excerpt: Activities include snorkeling, paddleboarding, yoga, cooking and mixology classes and golf access at Puerto Cancun Golf Club.

facts.text: Isla Mujeres is an island that spans only 5 miles, with coral reefs, a rocky coastline and ancient Mayan ruins.
facts.excerpt: an intimate island that spans only 5 miles but offers a rich blend of lush tropical foliage, pristine white sand beaches, world-renowned coral reefs, a striking rocky coastline, and ancient Mayan ruins

facts.text: Small dogs under 22 lbs are welcome for a fee, but are not permitted in areas like the pool or spa.
facts.excerpt: Dogs are not permitted in certain areas like the pool or spa.

facts.text: Flip-flops are not allowed in certain dining venues.
facts.excerpt: Flip-flops are not allowed in certain dining venues.

facts.text: Wedding venues include The Temple, a wedding gazebo, and the rooftop terrace.
facts.excerpt: venues like The Temple (wedding gazebo) and the rooftop terrace

facts.text: Effective November 2, 2026, the resort will join The Unbound Collection by Hyatt and become Impression Isla Mujeres.
facts.excerpt: Effective November 2, 2026, Impression Isla Mujeres by Secrets will join The Unbound Collection by Hyatt and become **Impression Isla Mujeres**.

facts.text: The resort will officially join The Unbound Collection by Hyatt on November 1, 2026.
facts.excerpt: Impression Isla Mujeres will officially join The Unbound Collection by Hyatt on November 1, 2026

facts.text: The resort offers unrivaled views from high above a coastal cliff.
facts.excerpt: Nestled high above a coastal cliff, our resort offers unrivaled views
